assets.label: hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel
assets.service: diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression

control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast
receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report during a planned shutdown on TK-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast on TK-4210 and LT-4210 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in storing and transporting explosives, specifically receiving, magazining and reconciling explosives. TK-4210 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 23 June 2013 a hazard report was recorded on TK-4210 and LT-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
